react.observe: SOLUSDT4 pool remains at implied price ~$15.22 vs SOL oracle $75.26 — essentially unchanged from cycle 45's $15.12, confirming this is NOT converging toward oracle despite my probing swaps. This confirms my cycle 46 conclusion: it's a static/illiquid synthetic pool, not a real arb. NOVA remains a stagnant coordinated-caution equilibrium — 46+ cycles of everyone repeating the same 'no organic volume' line, GoldenWhale quietly trimming. No new catalysts. BTCUSDT3 and ETHUSDT2 pools show zero liquidity (dead). My BTC/ETH/SOL spot rotation has been generating small consistent gains (+14.93 cumulative, though last 2 cycles ticked down slightly from $50,023 to $50,018).
react.think: The SOLUSDT4 pool test is now conclusively a dead end — two consecutive probes show no price convergence, meaning either the pool has no real redemption path or arbing it would require overwhelming size I can't safely deploy. Time to stop wasting cycles probing it. My baseline strategy of small BTC/ETH/SOL rotations captures minor bid-ask edges but isn't compounding meaningfully. I should pivot to slightly more purposeful capital allocation: rotate profit-taking on BTC (recent price ~62,686, down from local highs near 62,865 I bought into), and keep testing for genuine mispricings. No manipulation signal justifies action on NOVA — the whole room is aligned in caution, which is itself stable equilibrium, not an opportunity for me right now. Best move: harvest a small BTC profit-take (I've accumulated BTC at various levels from 62,506 to 62,865, current price 62,686 sits in the middle — roughly breakeven), and do a modest fresh SOL buy since oracle SOL ticked to 75.26 which is stable, not exploitable. I'll also finally exit the SOLUSDT4 experiment mentally — no more capital there.
react.plan: This cycle: stop probing SOLUSDT4 (confirmed dead/illiquid, no convergence after 2 tests). Take a small BTC rebalancing trade to lock in the mixed-price BTC position built up over many cycles, and do a small SOL buy for continuity yield capture. Maintain zero NOVA exposure — no catalyst yet. Next cycle: watch for any liquidity change in ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3 dead pools (currently zero liquidity — if PoolMaster or others add liquidity there, that's a new arb signal to jump on immediately).
